prompt:
Create a bold editorial breaking-news social graphic.

SUBJECT
Use the attached subject photograph as the primary subject, placed on the left half of the composition. Keep the subject photographic and naturally coloured. Do not distort, stylise or recolour the subject.

ACCENT COLOUR
Apply the selected accent colour (signal red (#DC2626)) to the bold geometric graphic elements in the background: a large vertical bar on the right, one or two horizontal rule lines, and a strong rectangular block behind the subject's head.

STYLE
Use a crisp Swiss-modernist graphic style with clean rules, strong geometric shapes, and disciplined negative space.

SPACE
Leave the right third of the composition free of the subject. This area will carry text overlaid in post-production.

FORMAT
Tall vertical 4:5 composition.

AVOID
Do not add any text, numbers, captions, logos or watermarks.

parts.label: Visual Style
parts.resolvedPhrase: Use a crisp Swiss-modernist graphic style with clean rules, strong geometric shapes, and disciplined negative space.
